text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
Rounding the 4th corner and into the straight!!
A roaring crowd welcomes them!!

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text: —HAAAAAAAAAAAAH!!!!

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text: (Waltz... Cure... Lapis——)

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
(This Derby that I ran with everyone...
I will never, ever forget it for the rest of my life...!!)

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text: The one who will wiiiin is MEEEEEE!!!

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text: Daaaaaaaaaaaahhh!!!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
Bubble Gum Fellow takes the lead!!
Bubble Gum Fellow unleashes an explosive final kick!!
Crossing the finish line in 1st place!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (WOOOOOOOH!!!!!)

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text: I did it……――――

text_block_list.name: The Four Heavenly Kings
text_block_list.text:
"Bubble...!!"
"Bubble!!"
"Bubble-chaaaan!!"

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text: Everyone...!

text_block_list.name: Sol Lapis
text_block_list.text:
I looooost!! It's so frustratiiiing!!
Bu-but congrats... co-o-ongraaaatss!!

text_block_list.name: Holy Cure
text_block_list.text: "...A complete defeat. Bubble, you always surpass my imagination."

text_block_list.name: Waltz of Shadow
text_block_list.text:
I'm truly happy I got to run alongside you today.
...Congratulations, Bubble.

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
...Everyone.
Thank you so much for the best race.

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text: Listen, can you hear it? That voice—

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
Congratulations, Bubble Gum Fellow—!!
All of the Big Four were amazing—!!

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text:
"That was the best Derby everーー!!
I'll keep cheering for youーー!!"

text_block_list.name: Spectator C
text_block_list.text:
"Show us an even more incredible race--!!
The Heavenly Kings are the beeeeeeest!!!"

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
—Everyone is watching us.
They're placing their hopes on the future of the Four Heavenly Kings!

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
Come autumn, let's drive the crowd into a frenzy with the Kikuka Sho and the Tenno Sho (Autumn)!
We're going to whip up an even bigger Four Heavenly Kings whirlwind!!

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text: And after that—

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
Let's definitely all run together again.
And have an even better race than today!

text_block_list.name: The Four Heavenly Kings
text_block_list.text:
"Yes...!"
"Yeah!"
"Yup!"

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text: —Hey there, Derby Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text: Fufu...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (WOOOOOOOH!!!!!)

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text: ...I've kept my promise, haven't I?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I will never forget
Bubble Gum Fellow's gallant figure
as he claimed victory in the Japan Derby.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"That from here on out and forevermore,
she would always remain my pride."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
With that conviction firmly in heart,
the Japanese Derby drew to a close—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: ――At a later date.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: ...Bubble Gum Fellow was being interviewed alongside the other members of the Big Four.

text_block_list.name: Interviewer
text_block_list.text:
—To the Four Heavenly Kings who've lit up the Classic
Year: will all of you be targeting the Kikuka Sho
this autumn?

text_block_list.name: Waltz of Shadow
text_block_list.text: Yes. Holy Cure, Sol Lapis, and I all intend to run in the Kikuka Sho.

text_block_list.name: Interviewer
text_block_list.text:
"Oh—
Is Bubble Gum Fellow currently not planning
to run in the Kikuka Sho?"

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text: Yes. I will not be running in the Kikuka Sho. Instead—

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text: I will run in the Tenno Sho (Autumn).

text_block_list.name: Interviewer
text_block_list.text: Huh!? T-That's...!!

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
—And I will win. Definitely.
So please, look forward to it.

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text: To the future success of us, the Four Heavenly Kings!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: This interview spread among race fans in an instant—

text_block_list.name: Race Fan A
text_block_list.text:
Hey, did you see this!?
Sounds like Bubble's aiming for the Tenno Sho (Autumn)!

text_block_list.name: Race Fan B
text_block_list.text:
Oh, right after last year's Satsuki Sho Umamusume?!
Does Bubble have a real shot at this...?

text_block_list.name: Race Fan C
text_block_list.text:
Eeeh?! The Four Heavenly Kings won't all be together for the Kikuka Sho?
The Japanese Derby was so intense, I was really looking forward to it, but—

text_block_list.name: Race Fan D
text_block_list.text:
I know, right?! When they've got a manga-like backstory like 'childhood friends from the same club',
you can't help but hope they race together!

text_block_list.name: Race Fan D
text_block_list.text:
Isn't it like... it's only the Big Four when all four are together?
Well, but if Bubble actually wins this, it'll definitely hype things up either way!

text_block_list.name: Race Fan E
text_block_list.text:
No, but seriously, like...
don't you feel like the Senior division is even more stacked this year compared to last...?

text_block_list.name: Race Fan F
text_block_list.text:
Totally!
I mean, the girls who beat that Triple Crown Umamusume Narita Brian are tearing it up on the front lines!

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text: —Alright then, let's review, shall we?

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
Our rivals standing in our way
at the Tenno Sho (Autumn)...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: ...The Tenno Sho (Autumn) that Bubble Gum Fellow is taking on gathers the very best among veteran Senior-class Umamusume.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: And the most noteworthy among them is—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"Having both experienced victory over the Triple Crown Umamusume Narita Brian,
they are currently the two Umamusume with the greatest momentum."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Last year, Mayano Top Gun conquered the Arima Kinen
as a Classic-class racer against the likes of Narita Brian,
putting her sheer brilliance on full display.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And the veteran Sakura Laurel,
who dramatically triumphed over Narita Brian
in a deadly duel at this year's Tenno Sho (Spring).

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Bubble Gum Fellow must fight seasoned veterans
alongside the "strongest" standing at the forefront of the era.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Depending on the case, some formidable rivals might even awaken heading into autumn—

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text: —Just what I wanted.

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
"If I'm going to take on the challenge, I want them to be the strongest Senior Class in history.
Because—"
choice_data_list: —That's the best way to prove you're the strongest...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"Yes. If our opponent is going to be formidable anyway,
and the hurdle extremely high, then—"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The more brutally difficult it is,
the more it proves a strength no one can dispute...!

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text: That's so us, isn't it!
choice_data_list: Let's get even stronger this summer!

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text: Yeah! And on to the stormy autumn!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Heading toward the decisive battle at the Tenno Sho (Autumn),
a trial-filled summer was fast approaching—
